title: Noether-Lefschetz Loci, Monodromy Representations, and Degree Thresholds for Hypersurfaces in Lean 4
description: Standalone Lean 4 formalization (`NoetherLefschetz/Basic.lean`, `NoetherLefschetz/Spec.lean`) and technical documentation (`docs/MONODROMY.md`, `docs/DEGREE_THRESHOLDS.md`, `docs/COUNTEREXAMPLES_CONTEXT.md`) of Noether-Lefschetz degree thresholds and generic Picard/Hodge rank restrictions for smooth projective hypersurfaces. This repository formalizes degree thresholds and Noether-Lefschetz structural specifications. It does not claim a proof or disproof of the Clay Hodge Conjecture.
